handoff: Slice 07 meets AC1–AC3 (B19, B20, D9) with S1 tests; unit, typecheck and human.test.ts are green. One nit: the AC2 test resets the remote label outside a finally.

findings.title: AC2 test resets the shared remote label outside a finally
findings.detail:
The B19 edited-label test changes t.remote.issues for #14 and puts it back only on its last line. If an assertion fails first, later tests in the describe see norn:wf:quick on #14. The B20 test resets labelError in a finally; this one does not.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Wrap the body in try/finally, as the B20 test does.
